methodology.note: Engineering estimates, not measured intelligence, consciousness, or production availability. Last validated cognitive/runtime head remains 621864d0d7f2676245383adab86f1dcc6d0f741f; historical CI rows remain tied to that SHA. Current source includes WorkPass343 substrate-tick reconciliation. WorkPass344 enforces metadata, UI and architecture checks; the CI-only cache override permits only untracked .pyc under __pycache__ and reports warnings, while tracked bytecode, stray bytecode and non-bytecode cache files still fail. Eight regression tests cover strict and CI modes. Prior run passed the broader integration and release gate before the final tracked-bytecode guard/test was added; a fresh exact-head CI run is pending. Scores unchanged; release archive and physical-device/hardware/soak/licensing gates remain open. WorkPass355 introduces safe, bounded and transactional CognitiveEventFabric snapshot restore. Its exact code/test checkpoint is 38b17bf610c06de1a23ba5e54d21cb4a1b7ac905 on branch fix/workpass355-safe-snapshot-restore-2026-10-26, based on 18afd253dcd7413c02136537ea1acc10b7764768. Exact-head CI PASS on PR head 0ad66d5519aedbadc317684504ed0e5a8e79412c: Unified project integration (#40289492932), progress-ledger integrity (#40289492966), WorkPass110 (#40289492891), P26 validation (#40289492875) and nine additional focused workflows all passed. Historical 13-row ciSnapshot remains pinned to 621864d0d7f2676245383adab86f1dcc6d0f741f; new validationRuns are recorded separately. No readiness scores were increased. WorkPass356 adds strict descriptor-only input ingress and non-coercive validation for CEF tool receipt trace, authoritative receipt revision and external observation APIs. Current code/test checkpoint c6845a5258a2c3bcdccce1089615cfabbfd4b750 on branch fix/workpass356-strict-tool-receipt-ingress-2026-10-26 is pending exact-head CI. The prior WorkPass355 exact-head validation record is preserved, as are all historical ciSnapshot SHAs and the existing progress scores. WorkPass356 exact PR-head CI PASS on d4ddbbe2495ca6523d4b2c4f04129bf487ab189b: Unified project integration (#40290594913), project progress-ledger integrity (#40290595259), WorkPass110 (#40290594892), P26 (#40290594766), and nine additional focused workflows all succeeded. The unified workflow passed cognitive integration contracts, governed approval E2E, public service startup, runtime/research bridge smoke and final release gates without publishing an archive. The legacy ciSnapshot remains pinned to its original tested SHA; these new exact-head results are listed separately. Readiness scores unchanged. WorkPass375 connects Hexis evidence to canonical MemoryOS2 using evidence digests, stance/provenance records and a bounded replay filter; exact-head validation is pending, scores remain unchanged, and no Release ZIP was changed. WorkPass380 repairs the Hexis review rollback regression: it tests absence of the canonical evidence receipt, replay identity and source trail, and verifies the same evidence ID can retry after the injected review-store failure is removed. Exact-head CI is pending for code/test commit 90f8b111d3e1d5b6b6e7b82f187eaf9ddb365e28; previous failing run is historical and not a PASS for this head. Readiness/progress scores are unchanged; main and canonical Release ZIP remain untouched. WorkPass381 updates the Hexis rollback regression to normalize missing optional fields to boolean checks; the fresh prior unified run 40304978396 failed only at the earlier assertion on the then-current head 1bc3f644ead3eb46c2eeddf10b9852d256ed98bc. The replacement code/test head is d6fbf28a61024f6739bcf4dfe1be58627cdf0da6 and needs fresh exact-head validation; no pass or readiness/retrieval uplift is claimed. Main and canonical Release ZIP remain unchanged.

dimensions.fieldEvidencePercent: Strength of independently verified results on realistic external tasks. Synthetic fixtures and internal unit tests do not count as field evidence.
dimensions.releaseReadinessPercent: Estimated completion of clean-machine install, runtime services, UI/voice, security, soak, licensing and reproducible archive requirements.

methodology.scoreScale: 0 = absent/unproven; 100 = evidenced against the lane's full stated release requirements.
